pages.text: That's the crest. The King's mark.$(br2)The star it dropped isn't just a trophy. There's a machine in a factory underground that hasn't moved in a hundred years, and a Nether Star is what wakes it. It has the last piece. Be quick.
$(o)The Setting of the Crown is with the Harbinger, switched off in a factory buried in the Overworld's caves.$()
